description_html:
The Complete Heir Hunting, Probate & Unclaimed Estate Recovery Field Manual

Turn research into a structured operating plan. This illustrated practitioner manual brings source-linked instruction, portal workflows, and actionable ProTips together in one organized reference.

  • Five practical chapters: foundations, workflows, visual exhibits, ProTips, and field worksheets
  • Visual evidence diagrams with detailed source-linked captions
  • Timestamped source links for direct access to tutorial passages
  • Printable checklists and due-diligence worksheets for findings, deadlines, and next actions

Move from understanding the domain to documenting your next action with a repeatable, step-by-step field workflow.
